text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The annual summer training camp has begun once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Depending on your mindset going into the camp,
the results can be magnified many times over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "I intend to spend a fruitful time without letting this opportunity go to waste."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! After all, 'one day at summer camp
is worth more than two regular days!'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
This is an irreplaceable opportunity to devote myself entirely to practice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I intend to overcome my own shortcomings at this training camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is fired up, too.
I have to do my best to make this a fulfilling training camp!
